design.affected_system: urban smoke exposure and clean-air protection system
alternatives: open large qualified facilities near transit
add small neighborhood clean-air rooms in access gaps
combine fixed centers with transport and portable filtration support
assumptions: Air-quality observations carry calibration, siting, and temporal metadata.
Indoor infiltration and filtration effects are measured locally or labeled assumptions.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
design.baseline: Only currently certified clean-air facilities operate.

constraints.description: Every selected center must pass indoor-air, power, accessible-entry, occupancy, and staffing requirements.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

design.decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
design.decision_owner: air-quality response coordinator and public-health director
design.decision_question: Where should verified clean-air spaces operate to maximize safe access during smoke events?

independence_key.binding_constraint: Every selected center must pass indoor-air, power, accessible-entry, occupancy, and staffing requirements.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Qualified facilities and validated travel networks support time-specific accessibility estimates.
independence_key.primary_outcome: high-risk residents beyond a qualified clean-air space

design.intended_claim: A versioned site design for comparing declared alternatives affecting public clean-air center network, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: high-risk residents beyond a qualified clean-air space
distributional gap in high-risk residents beyond a qualified clean-air space
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call an ordinary public building a clean-air center without indoor-air verification.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Qualified facilities and validated travel networks support time-specific accessibility estimates.

design.title: Site a network of public clean-air centers
transportability_risks: Smoke chemistry, building leakage, monitor density, and household behavior differ.
Regional forecasts and satellite products may have city-specific resolution limits.
